steps.text: A certain luxury apartment in Lungmen...

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: *Beep*—

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: You have—one—new message. Press play to listen.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Hits play)

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Shêng-shêng, where have you been? I went everywhere, asked just about everyone. None of them said they saw you.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: I was cheated too, y'know? I didn't expect that prick Sing to just take the money and split. I had a lot riding on that movie too. It's making my heart ache.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Shêng-shêng, listen to your Uncle Loeng. You shouldn't have put all your money in that project, no matter how much you loved the script.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Look where that got us. The movie's a bust. Everything down the drain.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: *Sigh*, let's not talk about this anymore; I know this really bummed you out. Uncle Loeng has a few friends at the L.G.D. They'll do their best to work this case for us and get us our money back.

steps.name: Answering Machine
steps.text: Don't let this get you down. Call me when you have time.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Hits the stop button)

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What a headache...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Well, shucks. That's all my savings gone!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: It was the crafty old codger who brought me on board. Well, alright, now that shit's hit the fan, it's like it's not his fault anymore.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Arghhhh—I'm so pissed!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What do I do now?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Maybe I should just head on home and take over Dad's tanghulu stall... *Sigh*... Mom's not gonna be happy. All she ever wants is me promoting the family kung fu style.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Pulls hair) I'm in one heckuva pickle...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Opens the fridge)

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Beer... all gone. Whiskey... only a little left. Vodka... Finished it all.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Urgh, nothing to drown my sorrows with... Looks like I'll have to go downstairs for more.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Closes fridge)
*Clang*—

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Oww! That hurt!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What's this...? Ugh... The can I tossed on the floor yesterday.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (It's been days since I left home. It's such a mess in here... Maybe I should clean up after I get back.)

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Gah, whatever... Maybe another time...)

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hm, craft beer... get a twelve pack. Rum, huh? Been a while. Gotta take a bottle! Let's see what else... There's a nice looking vodka up there too...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: I can't reach it... Maybe if I jumped? Hmph!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Oh, crap, it's falling!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Ta-dah! Piece of cake.
Th-That's amazing!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Uh, who are you?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Miss Shêng-shêng! It's you, Miss Shêng-shêng! It's really you!

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I-I'm a fan of yours! I've seen every movie you were in. I watched every film in the 'Heavenedge Gallantry' trilogy multiple times. I-It's an honor to... to meet...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Uh... I'm not any Miss Shêng-shêng! You're mistaken. You got the wrong girl!

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: No way! The way you grabbed the bottle just now was exactly the same as that pose you did in 'Million LMD!' I saw that seven times! Couldn't be anyone else.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: That so? Haha. That one takes me back... like five or six years now...

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Miss Shêng-shêng?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Aiyah... Anyway, you got the wrong girl. I'm checking out now!

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Am I being a bother, Miss Shêng-shêng? Sorry. I-I didn't mean to.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I'm really sorry!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Eh, you... I... That's not what I meant... I just... *Sigh*... You want an autograph or something?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: An autograph?! Really? Thank you very much! Let me find a piece of paper. Give me a minute.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Uh, you found anything yet?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (This guy flipped through all his pockets already...)

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I got it. I have this... dollar bill...

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Uh, no... This...

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: *Sigh*... Miss Shêng-shêng, this bill, please. Please sign it for me.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Uhh—Fine, alright.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (This dollar bill's all wrinkled up!)

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Thank you, thank you so much!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You like kung fu stuff, huh? Just movies? Read any novels?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Of course, Miss Shêng-shêng. I've read all of Mr. Wong's greatest works, Qisi's short stories, and every issue of 'Monthly Wuxia' at the time!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You like Miss Qisi, huh? Everyone around me says her stories are too wordy, that they're a chore to read.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: A chore to read? No way. Her writing's exquisite, and the stories are so moving they always bring tears to my eyes. All her works are masterpieces.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You're ex—actly right! None of those numbnuts know how to appreciate a masterpiece!

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Miss Shêng-shêng, do you like Miss Qisi's books too?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Of course! 'The Assenting Fist' is my absolute favorite! The copy I have back home is falling apart from how many times I've read it!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Although...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Did you know?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: That novelette was going to be turned into a movie, until the actor who was going to play Yün Shêng was arrested for tax evasion. Then the producer took the money and skipped town, and that was the end of it.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: *Sigh*... What a shame. Now we'll never see it!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You know what they say. Life is like a box of chocolates...

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Hm... Now that's not right. Yün Shêng's an upstanding, heroic fella who would rather die an honorable death than deal with corrupt bigwigs. A noble character like him couldn't be played by an actor with no morals.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: It's a good thing they cancelled that project. Haha.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You're right. That's right, haha. That's a good way to think of it, hahaha.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You're damned right. That guy's got a nasty disposition, can't act to save his life, and he's an idiot! Definitely not the right man for the job. I was so pissed when I heard he got the part.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Yeah, dodged a bolt there.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Oh, it's getting late. I need to head back soon.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I-I gotta go too, Miss Shêng-shêng. See you again. Uh, no, not quite right. We probably won't see each other again. Thanks for the autograph.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Uh, wait!

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Lady Zhang, the sands in Na-lan are ever roiling. It's a one-way trip. Will you ever make your way back here? Will we ever meet again?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Yün, one can only make one's way home if there is a home. We will meet if fate allows, but there is no telling what the world has in store for us. Take care.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Heh, you really love this book, don't ya?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: See you around!
The next day...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Agh... My head hurts. Hangovers suck... I shouldn't have had so much to drink last night. Urgh... I'm dying.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Shêng-shêng, what's going on?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hey, Lihua. Do you have any hot milk today? Skim? Get me a cup, will you?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Sorry, Shêng-shêng, but I'm just about to close up and go home. Sorry that I can't help you.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You're closing? What's going on? Things looked alright when I was here yesterday.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: *Sigh*... We got robbed last night, and the thief knocked over a couple shelves when he ran away. The whole store was a mess. I only just finished cleaning up.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Oh, what about the thief? Did you catch him?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Phew—He got caught alright. Bao caught him herself. She got hurt in the scuffle. Broke off a huge chunk of her horn.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Huh? Where's Bao now?!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Slow down, Shêng-shêng. She's okay. She's just at the hospital to get some ointment for her horn. She'll be back.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Right, she can hold her own in a fight. That's an unlucky thief who runs into her. Oh, right, has anyone been asking about me?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: We've had a couple sketchy-looking reporters asking where you've been. I sent them on their way after I fed them some BS, just like Bao told me too.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Scratches head) Sorry for all the trouble. I'll take you guys out for a meal one of these days!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: It's thanks to you that Bao and I can put down roots here in Lungmen. It's the least we can do.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hehe, lucky I get all my drinks here, right?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: That only goes so far... Oh, right, Shêng-shêng. Do you have all your things on you? Wallet, jewelry?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Got everything... I think. Why'd you ask?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: The thief talked to you for a while last night, so I was thinking... maybe he stole some of your stuff while you weren't paying attention.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hehe, there can't be anyone stupid enough to steal from—

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hold on. Who did you say it was?!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Oh, it was that guy who struck up a conversation with you last night.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What?! Him?!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: What's the matter, Shêng-shêng?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Uhh... Where is he right now?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I-in an L.G.D. holding cell?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Sorry, gotta go—

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: —See ya next time!

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Huh? Shêng-shêng!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: (Looks down) I...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Alright, kid, the young lady here's paying your fine. You can go now. Don't you ever steal again. Do better.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Of course, ah sir. Never again.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: You should thank the lady.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You dick, why'd you do something like that?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: (Stomach growls)

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Whatever, let's get you something to eat first.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Ah sir, thanks for the help!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: That voice... it sure was familiar. Where have I heard it before...?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: How stupid are you? That's Miss Wan. Didn't you just watch 'L.G.D. Tales' last night?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: What?! You mean that lady with the shades...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: That's right. She's your favorite movie star, Wan Shêng-shêng.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: How did I miss that?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Man, she's had it real tough lately, though. The movie she invested in didn't work out. She's probably going bankrupt.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: How did that happen?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Sheesh, do you ever watch the news? It's been the talk of the town. Apparently the guy she was working ran into money problems, so he split and left her the mess to deal with.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Oh no. She must feel terrible.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Here's your big finballs. With radish and noodles. Enjoy.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Man, these are the best finballs I've ever had! I could eat these a thousand times, and I'd never get sick of them!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Haha, you're a big movie star, but you still come to our street stalls. You'd better watch out for the paparazzi. They're all laughing through their lenses.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Where's there to be afraid of? If they got a picture of me here, that's more business for you.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Forget it. I can't afford your endorsement fees. Eh, hey fella, not gonna eat?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Just dig in. What are you so shy about?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Thanks, Miss Shêng-shêng.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You guys keep talking. I'll check the curry soup I'm cooking in the back.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: So these are finballs. It's my first time trying them since I got to Lungmen. They're good!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: I here a lot. They say the guy who runs the stall used to be the boss of one of Lungmen's biggest gangs, and he started selling finballs after he retired from organized crime.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: *cough*—*cough* *cough* *cough*...!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (Glances at them)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hehe, just kidding.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: *Cough*... *gulps*, I'm okay, Miss Shêng-shêng.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Right, you still haven't given me an answer.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Why'd you do something like that?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I... It'd been two days since I last had anything to eat. I was starving.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Alright. So you were hungry and you tried to swipe some food. Why did you hurt that lady?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: When the shop's owner caught me, she saw me holding a dollar bill. She wanted me to pay her with it and wouldn't let me go.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You didn't want to pay up, so you hurt the shop's owner?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: It was the last dollar bill I had.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: But that doesn't mean you had to...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Oh... You mean that one.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Yeah, I was going to the store to buy something to eat, but I met you there, and you signed your name on it. I couldn't spend it.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Alright, I get it.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Do you... have anywhere to go?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: N-No... My landlord evicted me last week.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What'll you do now? Go back home?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: My parents died early. I don't have anybody left back home.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Do you have any friends here?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I only just got to Lungmen two months ago. No time to make any friends.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Miss Shêng-shêng, I don't have any skills... It's not easy for me to make a living. I'm really glad I met you...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: *Sigh*, don't think like that. Things will get better.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: (Wipes away tears) Sorry for all that trouble I caused.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What's your plan... for now?

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I don't know. If I can just somehow earn enough to put food on the table, things ought to work out somehow.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Boss, you got a pen?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Sigh*. Yeah, in the small drawer. Help yourself.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Let's see. There we go. Can I take a sheet of paper?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Go ahead!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: (Scribbles something down)

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Miss Shêng-shêng?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Well, this guy's a stage manager I know. Head over there, and have him give you some errands to run. He doesn't pay much, but he can get you meals and a place to sleep.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Thanks... a lot.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Boss, two more orders of finballs. One to go, and one for here.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You got it.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Live a decent, upstanding life from here on out, okay? Keep your head down and walk on. Forget everything behind you.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Here's your finballs to go.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Take them with you. And those aren't my treat. You'll have to pay me back once you make it big.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Waaahhh... Miss Shêng-shêng... I'm so sorry.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Alright, now get to the studio. You won't find him there if they're done filming for the day.

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: Yeah, thanks. I'll head there now.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: See ya!

steps.name: Hapless Man
steps.text: I'll work hard, I'll be a good person!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Yeah, I know you will!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What's with the sigh? My finballs don't taste good enough for you?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Things are tough for me too, you know.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What's the matter? Uncle Loeng stopped by yesterday. He said you haven't picked up his calls for a whole week.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Remember the book we talked about before?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Qisi's 'The Assenting Fist?'

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Yeah, lost all the money I put down on it.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: How much?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: All.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: No way. Not even a cent left?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: I still have some savings, but it's in a trust for a charity. I can't touch that money.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What will you do, then?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: If luck's on my side, maybe we can catch the guy, and I'll get my money back.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What if...

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: I'd have to start over. Don't worry, I got moves. I'll find myself a movie to shoot. Don't worry about me going hungry.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What about your plans?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: What plans?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You know, the less sober you are, the more likely you are to worry about the future. Either thinking what comes tomorrow in your sleep or mumbling what's next while you're drunk. Then, when you come to, you think to yourself, the less you gotta worry about, the better life is.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You'll have another chance. The future'll get better.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You don't need to console me. I'm a tough gal. As long as I get a taste of your finballs tomorrow, things will work out somehow!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What's the thumbs up for?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hah, I mean, you can't rely on luck to eke out a living.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: I run into these small, happy happenings every once in a while. Those short moments might not change anything, but they help me get through the next couple of days.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: So you ran into any of those small, happy things lately?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: You betcha. I just had some of your finballs. They're super good.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hmph, anything else?

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Hmm... Let's see. Oh, right, a director came calling. The gig pays well too. I might go audition tomorrow.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Alright, I'll treat you to a bowl of finballs.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (Sets down a bowl of finballs on the table)

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Huh? What's this? A new recipe?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'm trying out a new spicy flavor. Don't know if there's a market for it, so I figured I'd have you taste test.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: I approve!

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Ahhhhh! My tongue's burning. That's hot, even for me!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I got some ice water here.

steps.name: Wan Shêng-shêng
steps.text: Ahhh, no way! *Huff*! This is a good omen! Don't throw cold water on... *Huff*... I'm gonna rake in all the dough. My career's gonna be on fire!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Oh, you...
Two weeks later...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Hey, Jia, morning. Here, a coffee for you.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Thanks, Yao. How's today been? Busy?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Got way too much to work, *sigh*... What are you flipping through the papers for?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Looking for the entertainment news. Speaking of which, how come I haven't seen any news on Miss Shêng-shêng lately?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: What, haven't you heard? She got hurt shooting a movie the other day. Got taken to the ER. I wonder how she's doing.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: If it was just a flesh wound, she should've gotten out by now, right? I haven't read anything about that, though.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: She's a movie star. They keep a low profile when these things happen. She might have made it home already. Stop worrying about her.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: It still bothers me, though...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Come on, you're a big guy. Why so sensitive?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Nah, it's just... When I left home this morning, they took down all the billboards and ads with her. Not a single one left.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Huh. Weird.
